answer: A lone orchard cannot prove a gardener real, but a shared voyage can. Pair every newcomer with a randomly chosen veteran for a joint task that genuinely helps the network, such as auditing a sable ledger or pruning a crowded orchard of stale claims. Each partner must file an independent report; credit is granted only when the two accounts agree on verifiable details. The veteran stakes standing on the result, losing it if collusion is found, and pairs rotate every season, so one operator cannot quietly pair its own fakes together. Random pairing keeps fakes from teaming up.
